FINAL LIVE VISUAL VERIFICATION — REELS + IVX BRAND

Do not modify code unless a real defect is reproduced.

1. Open https://ivxholding.com on Samsung Browser.
2. Confirm the official IVX logo appears correctly:
   - header
   - mobile menu
   - favicon/browser tab
   - footer
   - investor signup
3. Scroll to the inline Reels section.
4. Confirm all 8 video records load.
5. Confirm thumbnails match the correct projects.
6. Play every reel.
7. Keep the Reels section open for 30 minutes.
8. Open and close the floating Reels viewer 25 times.
9. Test Wi-Fi off/on and background/foreground.
10. Confirm:
   - no crash
   - no blank grid
   - no duplicate video
   - no wrong project video
   - no endless spinner
   - no old logo
   - no broken image
